paragraphs: R. Neḥunya, well-digger, beginning of Shekalim 5: the pious digger of trenches and wells for pilgrims, one of fifteen pious Temple appointees (see Matya ben Shemuel). His daughter fell into a well; R. Ḥanina ben Dosa said, 'At this hour she has come up,' Yevamot 121b; Bava Kamma 50a; Jerusalem Talmud. He testified before R. Yehudah, Sotah 18b.
